notes.title: Seven Nexus Update 4
notes.content: [h1]7X Monthly Update August 2025[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690305/7233c8bc43e79588461fc927e16c1835f2763a50.png"][/img][/p][p]Soul Seekers, it’s been a few weeks since the Seven Nexus Demo was launched, and we wanted to take the time to give everyone an update about the game, as well as some teasers of what’s to come! Please read the full text of the update, as it contains information for all fans of Seven Nexus![/p][p][/p][h2]Thank you![/h2][p]First up, we wanted to say thank you so much to everyone who played the demo, shared your thoughts, and supported Seven Nexus! This game has always been a very personal project, bringing us much joy and pain sometimes. It’s about love and loss, but also the connections that make life worth living. It’s about cherishing the moments we share, even if they’re short and fleeting. We hope that Grey’s journey will take you to places you didn’t expect, make you laugh and cry, and hopefully stay with you as a precious memory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690305/f13a1a7dfd977e6d56503ebb7ced3e1413f9684b.png"][/img][/p][p]Seeing so many of you already care about Grey, Haelo, Horne, and Elie means the world to us! We were absolutely blown away by such a warm response! Your comments, questions, and theories about everything that happened and what lies ahead in the next Trials make us smile every time we read them. Please keep them coming! They not only motivate us but also remind us that these characters are becoming just as alive for you as they are for us.[/p][h2]Is Seven Nexus for me?[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690305/babe62d8b0e500ddafa7b628ee15ee3262bd3794.png"][/img][/p][p]For those who haven’t tried the game yet, let us give you some more details! You probably already know that in Seven Nexus you can romance either an angel or a devil, but we wanted to go beyond and create a truly versatile experience. Your choices don’t just shape the story, they also shape your relationship. Both Haelo and Horne can be either the top or the bottom in every chapter. We hope this gives you a deeply personal and satisfying experience with plenty of reasons to replay the game.[/p][p] [/p][p]Beyond romance, Seven Nexus is also about moral dilemmas - the kind where the “right” answer isn’t always obvious. What if virtue doesn’t feel like the best choice? What if sin is the only way to truly help someone, even if it comes at a price? Each chapter introduces a new central character struggling with their own conflict, and their fate will be in your hands.[/p][p] [/p][p]We dive into heavy and painful topics, but we’ve worked hard to fill the story with warmth, heartfelt moments, and even humor. It’s a difficult balance, but we believe life is all about that balance too.[/p][h2]Please Wishlist on Steam![/h2][p]Please help us by wishlisting the game on Steam! It really helps us reach more players and keeps you updated on every big announcement and release. Your wishlists go a long way in making sure Grey’s journey can continue.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603420/Seven_Nexus/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What’s to come![/h2][p]Right now, we’re hard at work on the next chapter of the story. Without spoiling too much, expect a new face, and new dilemmas that will really test what “right” and “wrong” mean in Grey’s world. Not only that, but Haelo’s and Horne’s story will be explored in even more detail. Each Trial is going to push the boundaries of what love and desire is, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690305/b6cc14182708aaed6f5696e05553d095a6b862b7.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you again for sharing this moment with us. Seven Nexus wouldn’t be the same without you![/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll have more updates in the future, so please stay tuned![/p][p]~HeartSkip Games Team[/p]
